critical_code_review_comments: UserStreamingApp.jsx is now 6850 lines - still exceeds the 700-line threshold. Recommend splitting MiniPlayer, FullPlayer, ListItem, AlbumView, ProfileView, LegalPage into separate files under /app/frontend/src/components/streaming/ for maintainability.

MiniPlayer Heart quick-action button (line 2621) is missing a data-testid attribute. Recommend adding data-testid='mini-player-like-btn' or similar for consistency with Download/AddToPlaylist siblings.
Duplicate share/download/add-to-playlist logic still exists across MiniPlayer, FullPlayer, ListItem, and AlbumView. Extract into useSongActions() hook or shared helper.

Good: data-testid coverage on new ListItem dropdown (song-more-menu-{i}, song-menu-like/share/add-playlist-{i}) and album-level buttons (album-download-btn, album-add-playlist-btn) is consistent and testable.
test_credentials: Not required - all tests performed as unauthenticated user on live preview URL.
